entries.summary: Removed the repo-wide change-freeze enforced by the unified-skillpack conformance check (tools/validate_unified_skillpacks.py, from the now-inert .claude/skillpacks/ migration). It fail-closed on any file changed outside a fixed allowed_change_paths list since a pinned base commit, which blocked ordinary, unrelated PRs. Replaced with a passive, non-enforcing record of files changed since the pinned base. This governance/change_log.json file is introduced at the same time as the self-tracker every federation repo now carries.
